title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1985-07-14

ai_review.summary: Energetic show with the whole band on fire and standout China > Rider and Estimated; recording quality not detailed but the performance makes it worth listening.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise a high‑energy performance where Jerry Garcia “rides the wave” and the band stays hot throughout. Highlights mentioned are the China > Rider segue and the Estimated jam, and the concert is described as dance‑in‑the‑dirt fun. No specific comments on the recording’s source or fidelity were provided.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 4‑star reviews emphasize strong musical performance and overall enjoyment; lack of technical detail lowers confidence slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on sound clarity or mix; reviewers imply the recording is listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy set with seamless transitions, especially noted in the China > Rider sequence and a lively Estimated jam.
